meta.title: 凡人修仙传 完整地理数据 (A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality - Complete Geographic Reference)
meta.author: 忘语 (Wang Yu)
meta.description: Comprehensive geographic data across Mortal Realm (人界), Spirit Realm (灵界), and Immortal Realm (仙界), compiled from novel text, fan wikis, and reader analysis.
meta.dataQuality: Fan-compiled from novel text. Author did not publish an official world map. Some spatial relationships remain debated among readers.
meta.format: Structured for interactive map website development

realmStructure.description: The universe consists of multiple hierarchical realms. Cultivators ascend from lower to higher realms.

parallelRealms.name: 魔界 (Demon Realm)
parallelRealms.note: Periodically intersects with Spirit Realm causing 魔劫 (Demon Calamity)

parallelRealms.name: 冥界 (Netherworld/Underworld)
parallelRealms.note: Handles reincarnation; relatively weaker than other realms

parallelRealms.name: 灰界 (Gray Realm)
parallelRealms.note: Appears in Immortal Realm arc; has 洗煞池 (Pool of Cleansing)

parallelRealms.name: 广寒界 (Guanghan Realm)
parallelRealms.note: A special trial dimension accessible from Spirit Realm

parallelRealms.name: 小修罗界 (Minor Shura Realm)
parallelRealms.note: Where Han Li obtained 光阴之丝 (Thread of Time)

realmGroups.description: The cosmos is organized into realm groups (界群). The story is set in 小南洲界群 (Xiaonanzhou Realm Group).

mortalRealm.name: 人界 (Mortal Realm)
mortalRealm.description: The lowest cultivation realm. Multiple continents and seas. Han Li's home realm.

tiannan.name: 天南 (Tiannan)
tiannan.description: Han Li's homeland region. Composed of dozens of small-to-medium countries. Relatively poor in spiritual resources. Approximately 1/10 the size of Dajin.

powerBlocs.name: 正道盟 (Righteous Dao Alliance)
powerBlocs.leader: 至阳上人 (Zhiyang Shangren, Late Nascent Soul)

powerBlocs.name: 魔道六宗 (Six Devil Dao Sects)
powerBlocs.leader: 合欢老魔 (Hehuan Laomo, Late Nascent Soul)

powerBlocs.name: 九国盟 (Nine Nations Alliance)
powerBlocs.location: 南部 (South Tiannan, border with Mulan Grasslands)
powerBlocs.leader: 魏无涯 (Wei Wuyai, Late Nascent Soul)
powerBlocs.hqLocation: 阗天城 (Tiantian City), 虞国境内 (within Yu Country)
powerBlocs.leadSect: 化意门 (Huayi Sect) - led by 魏无涯 (Wei Wuyai, Late Nascent Soul)
powerBlocs.note: Defensive military alliance formed by 9 southern countries to resist Mulan Grassland invasions. After Devil Dao invasion, Yue's 6 refugee sects fled here and re-established in 北凉国.

powerBlocs.name: 天道盟 (Heavenly Dao Alliance)
powerBlocs.leader: 龙晗/凤冰夫妇 (Long Han & Feng Bing, Mid Nascent Soul), based at 鸾鸣宗 (Luanming Sect)
powerBlocs.note: Later dominated by Han Li through Luoyun Sect

countries.name: 越国 (Yue Country)
countries.size: 中等 (Medium), ~1/3 of Tianluo or Fengdu

borders.east: 姜国/车骑国 → 天罗国

countries.totalPrefectures: 镜州, 建州, 岚州, 蔺州, 溪州, 允州, +7 unnamed in novel
countries.note: Yue is a medium country, ~1/3 the size of Tianluo or Fengdu. Sandwiched between Righteous (West) and Devil (East) Dao blocs. After Devil Dao invasion, the country was overrun.

keyLocations.name: 彩霞山/落凤山 (Caixia Mountain/Luofeng Mountain)
keyLocations.description: Site of 七玄门 (Seven Mysteries Sect)

prefectures.name: 建州 (Jianzhou)
prefectures.location: 越国北部, bordering 元武国

keyLocations.name: 太岳山脉 (Taiyue Mountains)
keyLocations.description: Largest mountain range in Jianzhou, spanning thousands of li. HQ of 黄枫谷.

keyLocations.name: 血色禁地 (Bloody Forbidden Zone)
keyLocations.description: Ancient wind-sealed zone in northern Jianzhou. Only accessible to Qi Condensation cultivators. Site of 太南小会 trials.

sevenSects.name: 掩月宗 (Yanyue/Hidden Moon Sect)
sevenSects.description: Strongest of the 7. Controlled 3+ prefectures. 南宫婉's sect. After retreat: relocated to 玲珑山, 北凉国.

sevenSects.name: 黄枫谷 (Yellow Maple Valley)
sevenSects.description: Han Li's sect. Located in 太岳山脉, 建州. After retreat: relocated to 北凉国.

sevenSects.name: 灵兽山 (Spirit Beast Mountain)
sevenSects.description: Beast-taming sect in 岚州. Secretly a branch of Devil Dao's 御灵宗 (spy within the 7 sects).

sevenSects.name: 巨剑门 (Giant Sword Gate)
sevenSects.description: Sword cultivation sect. Controlled 1 prefecture. Fled to Nine Nations Alliance.

sevenSects.name: 天阙堡 (Tianque Fortress)
sevenSects.description: Fortress sect. Controlled 1 prefecture. Fled to Nine Nations Alliance.

sevenSects.name: 清虚门 (Qingxu Gate)
sevenSects.description: Daoist sect. Controlled 1 prefecture. Fled to Nine Nations Alliance.

sevenSects.name: 化刀坞 (Hua Blade Dock)
sevenSects.description: Blade cultivation sect. Controlled 1 prefecture. Fled to Nine Nations Alliance.

countries.name: 元武国 (Yuanwu Country)
countries.description: Medium country bordering Yue. Later dominated by Devil Dao's 魔焰门.

countries.name: 紫金国 (Zijin Country)
countries.description: Medium country. Member of Nine Nations Alliance. Contains an ancient teleportation formation to Scattered Star Seas.

countries.name: 天罗国 (Tianluo Country)
countries.location: 天南东部 (East Tiannan, east of Yue across Jiang/Cheqi buffer states)
countries.description: Major country. HQ of the Devil Dao 6 Sects.

countries.name: 风都国 (Fengdu Country)
countries.location: 天南西部 (West Tiannan, west of Yue)
countries.description: Major country. HQ of the Righteous Dao Alliance.

countries.name: 溪国 (Xi Country)
countries.description: Home of 云梦山三派 (Three Sects of Cloud Dream Mountain). Han Li joined 落云宗 here.

keySects.name: 落云宗 (Luoyun/Falling Cloud Sect)
keySects.note: Han Li's sect after returning from Scattered Star Seas. Eventually became Tiannan's #1 sect.

countries.name: 姜国 (Jiang Country)
countries.description: Small buffer state between Yue and Tianluo. First invaded by Devil Dao.

countries.name: 车骑国 (Cheqi Country)
countries.description: Small buffer state between Yue and Tianluo.

countries.name: 花雨国 (Huayu Country)
countries.description: Northern Tiannan, near Xi Country. Part of Heavenly Dao Alliance.

countries.name: 刹云国 (Chayun Country)
countries.description: Near Yuanwu Country. Part of Heavenly Dao Alliance.

countries.name: 望水国 (Wangshui Country)
countries.description: Western Tiannan. Member of Righteous Dao Alliance.

countries.name: 北凉国 (Beiliang Country)
countries.description: Southern Tiannan, Nine Nations Alliance member. 掩月宗 relocated to 玲珑山 here. 黄枫谷 also relocated here.

countries.name: 朔国 (Shuo Country)
countries.description: Southern Tiannan, Nine Nations Alliance member.

countries.name: 磐国 (Pan Country)
countries.description: Southern Tiannan, Nine Nations Alliance member.

countries.name: 阳谷国 (Yanggu Country)
countries.description: Southern Tiannan, Nine Nations Alliance member.

countries.name: 朱崖国 (Zhuya Country)
countries.description: Southern Tiannan, Nine Nations Alliance member.

countries.name: 桑渊国 (Sangyuan Country)
countries.description: Southern Tiannan, Nine Nations Alliance member.

forbiddenZones.name: 坠魔谷 (Demon Fall Valley)
forbiddenZones.description: Ancient battlefield where cultivators fought demons. The main ancient demon force was sealed here. 古魔血焰 was split-sealed: body in special space, twin souls imprisoned in 血咒之门. Extremely dangerous even for Nascent Soul cultivators. Contains 灵缈园.

neighbors.south: 慕兰草原 (Mulan Grasslands) via 九国盟 border
neighbors.east: 无边海 → 乱星海 (Scattered Star Seas)

dajin.name: 大晋 (Dajin)
dajin.description: The undisputed #1 cultivation region in the Mortal Realm. 10x larger than Tiannan. Dense spiritual energy, rich resources. Called 'Holy Land of Cultivation' (修仙圣地).
dajin.totalDeityTransformations: Multiple (向之礼, 呼老魔, 白老鬼, 车老妖, etc.)

topPowers.name: 太一门 (Taiyi Sect)
topPowers.hq: 真桓山 (Zhenhuan Mountain), one of Dajin's 4 Great Spirit Veins, spanning 100,000 li
topPowers.description: Strongest sect in Dajin. Controls hundreds of spirit mountains.

topPowers.name: 天魔宗 (Tianmo Sect)
topPowers.leader: 呼庆雷/呼老魔 (Hu Qinglei, Deity Transformation, #1 Devil Cultivator in Mortal Realm)

topPowers.name: 万妖谷 (Ten Thousand Demon Valley)
topPowers.leader: 车老妖 (Che Laoyao, Deity Transformation, ancient demon beast)
topPowers.description: Only organized demon beast cultivator sect in the Mortal Realm. 车老妖 bound here by ancient pact.

topPowers.name: 皇族叶家 (Imperial Ye Family)
topPowers.description: #1 cultivation clan in Mortal Realm. ~20 Nascent Soul cultivators, 2 Late Nascent Soul. Annihilated after Kunwu Mountain incident.

topPowers.name: 小极宫 (Xiaoji Palace)
topPowers.description: Ice Soul Fairy's lineage. Comparable to top-10 sects.

righteousTenSects: 岳阳宫 (Yueyang Palace) - 陇洲, 西川府, 南天峰
真极门 (Zhenji Sect) - parent of Tiannan's 太真门
泰阳门 (Taiyang Sect) - 五原府, 辽洲
九仙宫 (Jiuxian Palace) - 关宁府, 辽洲
雷音宗 (Leiyin Sect) - Buddhist, 3 Late Nascent Soul
金罗宗/金罗门 (Jinluo Sect) - Buddhist
devilTenSects: 阴罗宗 (Yinluo Sect) - destroyed by Han Li

knownCommanderies.name: 辽洲 (Liao)
knownCommanderies.description: Snowy region. Contains 关宁府 (Guanning Prefecture)

knownCommanderies.name: 陇洲 (Long)
knownCommanderies.key: 西川府, 天岳山脉·南天峰 - 岳阳宫 HQ

knownCommanderies.name: 玉州 (Yu)
knownCommanderies.key: Imperial Ye Family HQ, 晋京 (Jinjing capital)

knownCommanderies.name: 南疆 (Nanjang)
knownCommanderies.key: 南疆府, 潮云府; 火狱 forbidden zone

keyLocations.name: 晋京 (Jinjing)
keyLocations.location: 邻近金江郡, near 玉州
keyLocations.description: Imperial capital of Dajin. Political and cultivation hub.

keyLocations.name: 昆吾山 (Kunwu Mountain)
keyLocations.description: 'Nascent Soul Meat Grinder'. Ancient immortal mountain sealed after demon invasion. Contained 元刹圣祖 split soul, 通天灵宝 八灵尺 and 黑风旗. Final death toll: 33 Nascent Soul cultivators including 11 Late Nascent Soul. Later destroyed by Mahayana Han Li who slapped it into the void.

keyLocations.name: 魔陀山 (Motuo Mountain)
keyLocations.description: 天魔宗 base, 呼老魔's demon palace.

keyLocations.name: 火狱 (Fire Prison)
keyLocations.description: One of the 7 Great Forbidden Zones.

keyLocations.name: 苦竹岛 (Kuzhu Island)
keyLocations.description: Home of 苦竹老人 (Kuzhu Elder).

scatteredStarSeas.name: 乱星海 (Scattered Star Seas)
scatteredStarSeas.nameEn: Scattered Star Seas / Luan Xing Hai
scatteredStarSeas.description: Vast ocean with countless islands. East of Tiannan continent. Richest region for demon beast resources in the Mortal Realm. Han Li's 'fortune-making' region.
scatteredStarSeas.relativeLocation: 天南以东 (East of Tiannan), across vast Unbounded Sea

innerSea.name: 内星海 (Inner Star Sea)
innerSea.description: Human-dominated, orderly. Ruled by Star Palace.

majorIslands.name: 天星城 (Tianxing City)
majorIslands.description: Built on a giant island in Inner Sea. Core: 圣山 (Sacred Mountain) with 50+ levels. Layer 1: markets/auction houses. Layer 39: rental caves (2700 spirit stones/century). Layer 50: Star Palace main hall + teleportation arrays. Ruled by 天星双圣 (Twin Sages, 2 Late Nascent Soul).

majorIslands.name: 南明岛 (Nanming Island)
majorIslands.description: Outer transit island near Tianxing City.

majorIslands.name: 魁星岛 (Kuixing Island)
majorIslands.description: Southwest corner of Inner Sea, one of 3 major SW islands (with 尾星岛 and 桑星岛). Han Li's first landing point in Scattered Star Seas. Contains 魁星城, 天都街, 云梦阁, 山海阁, 六连殿. Adjacent: 金鳖岛, 小寰岛 (Xiaohuan Island - Han Li's secluded cultivation spot). Nearby mountains: 青云山 (天柱峰, 天宵峰, 天门峰).

majorIslands.name: 双峰岛 (Shuangfeng Island)
majorIslands.description: Hosts teleportation array to Outer Sea.

majorIslands.name: 皇明岛 (Huangming Island)
majorIslands.description: Medium island, Devil Dao territory. Has outer sea teleportation array.

majorIslands.name: 魔湖岛 (Mohu Island)
majorIslands.description: Near demon beast territory. 蛮胡子 cave residence.

majorIslands.name: 极阴岛 (Jiyin Island)
majorIslands.description: 极阴祖师 territory. Above it floats 虚天殿.

outerSea.name: 外星海/妖海 (Outer Star Sea / Demon Sea)
outerSea.description: Dominated by demon beasts. Resource-rich but extremely dangerous. Requires teleportation for practical travel.

majorIslands.name: 奇渊岛 (Qiyuan Island)
majorIslands.description: Major Outer Sea hub. 黑石城 (Black Stone City) with shops. 碧云门 territory. Near vast demon beast abyss. 风希 (Feng Xi, 9th-grade demon beast) had lair here. Han Li forced to help refine 风雷翅 here.

majorIslands.name: 碧灵岛 (Biling Island)
majorIslands.description: North of 银鲨岛. Contains the ONLY spirit stone mine in Scattered Star Seas. Han Li killed 金蛟王 here for top-grade spirit stones.

specialLocations.name: 虚天殿 (Xutian Palace)
specialLocations.description: Hovers above 极阴岛海域. Built by 冰魄仙子. Ancient relic containing 虚天鼎 (Heavenly Void Cauldron), 乾蓝冰焰, 九曲灵参, 养魂木, 啼魂兽. Opens every 300 years. Han Li obtained 虚天鼎 here. Also seals 银月 (Snowling/Linglong's second clone).

mulanGrasslands.name: 慕兰草原/天澜草原 (Mulan Grasslands / Tianlan Grasslands)
mulanGrasslands.description: Vast nomadic cultivation region between Tiannan (north) and Dajin (south). Perpetual tribal warfare.
mulanGrasslands.relativeLocation: 天南以南/大晋以北 (South of Tiannan, North of Dajin)

tribes.name: 慕兰族 (Mulan Tribe)
tribes.location: 东部草原 (East side, near Tiannan border)
tribes.culture: Worship 火灵神禽 (Fire Spirit Divine Bird). Cultivators called 法士 (Fashi/Sorcerers).
tribes.situation: Sandwiched between Tiannan and Tuwu. Repeatedly invaded Tiannan through Nine Nations Alliance border.

tribes.name: 突兀人 (Tuwu People)
tribes.location: 西部/北部草原 (West/North side, near Dajin border)
tribes.culture: Worship 天澜圣兽 (Tianlan Sacred Beast). Cultivators called 仙师 (Xianshi/Immortal Masters).
keyFigures: 天澜圣女林银屏 (Tianlan Holy Maiden Lin Yinping)

mulanGrasslands.spatialLayout: Tiannan (N) → 九国盟防线 → 慕兰族 (E side) / 突兀人 (W side) → Dajin (S)

fiveDragonSeas.name: 五龙海 (Five Dragon Seas)
fiveDragonSeas.description: Islands and sea territory. Contains a stable space node leading to Spirit Realm. Cultivation strength roughly equal to Tiannan.
fiveDragonSeas.relativeLocation: 宽广无边海域 (Part of the broader Unbounded Sea system)
notables: 白鹿老怪 (White Deer Old Monster, Deity Transformation) once resided here
fiveDragonSeas.keyFeature: Stable space node to Spirit Realm - Han Li and 冰凤 used this to enter Spirit Realm

extremeWest.name: 极西之地 (Extreme West)
extremeWest.description: Desert wasteland directly west of Tiannan. 千竹教 (Qianzhu Sect) headquarters here. Han Li traveled here at Nascent Soul stage.
extremeWest.relativeLocation: 天南以西, 直接相邻 (West of Tiannan, directly adjacent)

tianShaContinent.name: 天沙大陆 (Tian Sha Continent)
tianShaContinent.description: Separate continent reached by sea. Han Li came here at Deity Transformation stage to seize 金烁环.
tianShaContinent.relativeLocation: 另一片海域可达的大陆 (Another continent reachable by sea)

unboundedSea.name: 无边海 (Unbounded Sea)
unboundedSea.description: Vast boundary ocean. 'Even immortals cannot cross.' Murky waters, few fish survive. Connects all Mortal Realm regions.
unboundedSea.relativeLocation: 天南以北, 连接所有区域 (North of Tiannan, connects all regions)

travelRoutes.route: 九国盟 → 慕兰草原 → 大晋

spiritRealm.name: 灵界 (Spirit Realm)
spiritRealm.description: The middle realm. Three major continents plus surrounding seas. Home to hundreds of races.
spiritRealm.maxCultivation: 大乘期 (Mahayana) - can stay; must ascend to Immortal Realm to reach True Immortal

tianyuan.name: 风元大陆/天元大陆 (Fengyuan/Tianyuan Continent)
tianyuan.description: The continent where Han Li landed in Spirit Realm. Most fragmented in terms of racial power - no super-dominant races. Home to many middle-to-small races. Actually contains the most hidden top-tier experts.

races.name: 人族 (Human Race)
races.description: Forcibly broke into Spirit Realm from another realm. Relatively short history. 3 domains: 天元境, 玄武霸城, 天妙境 (West/East/North). Over 110合体期, 2大乘期.

keyLocations.name: 天渊城 (Tianyuan City)
keyLocations.description: Human race's southern fortress. Key阵眼 of the 三皇七地 super formation. Guards against demon realm invasions. 飞升者 must serve as 青冥卫/天渊卫 to earn 灭尘丹 and freedom.

keyLocations.name: 安远城 (Anyuan City)
keyLocations.description: Han Li's first human city after arriving in Spirit Realm.

keyLocations.name: 虞阳城 (Yuyang City)
keyLocations.description: Where Han Li trained 金刚诀.

keyLocations.name: 落日城/落日之墓 (Luori City/Sunset Tomb)
keyLocations.description: Where Han Li fused divine flame, obtained 豹麟兽 and 灵族神血.

races.name: 妖族 (Demon Beast Race)
races.territory: 西北角, 与人族相邻 (Northwest, adjacent to Humans)

races.name: 飞灵族 (Feiling/Spirit Flight Race)
races.territory: 风元大陆东端 (East end of continent)
races.description: 72 branches, all flying bird races. Ancient race spanning millions of years. 天鹏族 is one branch. 3-4+ Mahayana experts.
races.keyLocation: 飞灵族半岛 (Feiling Peninsula) - where Han Li was accidentally teleported to

races.name: 蜉蝣族 (Fuyou/Mayfly Race)
races.territory: 风元大陆南端 (South end, south of Feiling)
races.description: Top-10 ranked race in Spirit Realm. Multiple Mahayana experts. Has a 渡劫期 grand elder (虚灵). Owns one 玄天之宝. Controls 地渊 (Earth Abyss) and 冥河神乳 pool.

keyZones.name: 地渊 (Earth Abyss)
keyZones.location: 蜉蝣族和飞灵族之间 (Between Feiling and Fuyou territory)
keyZones.description: Underground world controlled by Fuyou Race. Contains passage to 冥河之地 (Nether River Land). Multiple layers. 四大妖王 (4 Demon Kings, all合体期) operated here. Access requires payment to Fuyou Race.

keyZones.name: 冥河之地 (Nether River Land)
keyZones.location: 地渊深处 (Deep within Earth Abyss)
keyZones.description: Contains 冥河神乳 (Nether River Divine Milk). Han Li met 青元子 (Qing Yuanzi) here.

leiming.name: 雷鸣大陆 (Thunder Continent)
leiming.description: The continent with the strongest surface-level power. Most unified racial blocs.

races.name: 角蚩族 (Jiaochi Race)
races.territory: 雷鸣大陆西边 (West side of Thunder Continent)
races.description: Ranked top-5 in Spirit Realm. Across the sea from Feiling Race.
keyLocations: 魔金山脉 (Magic Gold Mountains) - where Han Li obtained giant ape true blood

races.name: 天云十三族 (Tianyun Thirteen Races)
races.description: Alliance of 13 races on Thunder Continent. 绿光族 (Green Light Race) is one member - Han Li joined them.
keyLocations: 天云城 (Tianyun City) - center of activities

xuetian.name: 血天大陆 (Blood Sky Continent)
xuetian.description: The smallest of the three continents. Dominated by blood-path sects rather than races.

races.name: 血骨门 (Xuegu Sect)
races.description: Dominant blood-path sect on Blood Sky Continent.

guanghanRealm.name: 广寒界 (Guanghan Realm)
guanghanRealm.description: Special trial dimension created by ancient True Immortals. Different time flow rate. Accessed via 广寒令 and exclusive teleportation array. Han Li reached late-stage 炼虚 through 星图灌体 here. Obtained 炼神术, 太乙青山, 金剑图, etc.
guanghanRealm.returnDestination: Can be used to return to 风元大陆

crossContinentTravel.description: Han Li was accidentally teleported from 风元大陆 to 雷鸣大陆. The three continents are separated by vast oceans. Travel requires either ultra-long-range teleportation or extended flight.

superPowersInSpiritRealm.name: 三皇七妖王 (Three Emperors and Seven Demon Kings)
superPowersInSpiritRealm.description: Human race's top forces. The 3 Emperors and 7 Demon Kings built the 三皇七地 super formation with 天渊城 as key 阵眼.

demonRealmConnection.description: Spirit Realm and Demon Realm periodically intersect, causing 魔劫 (Demon Calamity). 天渊城 is the primary defensive point for the human race against demon invasions.

immortalRealm.name: 仙界 (Immortal Realm)
immortalRealm.description: The highest realm. Home to True Immortals and Dao Ancestors. Contains ~3000 immortal domains (仙域) ranging from grand to minor.
immortalRealm.realmCount: 36 top-level grand domains, 500 intermediate domains, 3000 minor immortal domains

spatialLayers.name: 天风域 (Tianfeng Domain)
spatialLayers.description: Filled with九天罡风/黑垩风 (Heavenly Winds)

spatialLayers.name: 天外域 (Tianwai Domain)
spatialLayers.description: Home of extraterritorial heavenly demons (域外天魔), led by 天魔道祖隐明

heavenlyCourt.name: 天庭 (Heavenly Court)
heavenlyCourt.description: The supreme governing body of the Immortal Realm. Multi-Dao-Ancestor central government.

sevenLords.name: 古或今 (Gu Huojin)
sevenLords.role: 天庭掌权者 (Ruler of Heavenly Court)

sevenLords.name: 李元究 (Li Yuanjiu)
sevenLords.dao: 金之本源道祖 (Metal Origin Dao Ancestor)

sevenLords.name: 轩辕杰 (Xuanyuan Jie)
sevenLords.dao: 土之本源道祖 (Earth Origin Dao Ancestor)

sevenLords.name: 赤融 (Chi Rong)
sevenLords.dao: 火之本源道祖 (Fire Origin Dao Ancestor)

sevenLords.name: 陈如烟 (Chen Ruyan)
sevenLords.dao: 水之本源道祖 (Water Origin Dao Ancestor)

sevenLords.name: 隐明 (Yin Ming)
sevenLords.dao: 天魔道祖 (Heavenly Demon Dao Ancestor)

subOrganizations: 仙宫 (Immortal Palaces - local governing bodies in each domain)

reincarnationPalace.name: 轮回殿 (Reincarnation Palace)
reincarnationPalace.description: Cross-domain resistance force against Heavenly Court. Recruits oppressed talents. Has 轮回之子 system. Sub-forces include: 十方楼, 无常盟.

knownImmortalDomains.name: 中土仙域 (Zhongtu Immortal Domain)
knownImmortalDomains.description: Largest immortal domain. Heavenly Court headquarters. Time Dao Ancestor 古或今's domain.

daoAncestorRules.description: Dao Ancestors are the highest cultivation level. They must bind to a specific immortal domain - their true body cannot leave it. Overusing 'Dao' power leads to merging with Heavenly Dao. Three supreme laws: 混沌 > 时间 > 轮回 > 空间 > 五行本源

sevenMysteriesSect.name: 七玄门 (Seven Mysteries Sect)
sevenMysteriesSect.location: 越国 → 镜州 → 彩霞山/落凤山 (Yue Country, Jingzhou, Caixia Mountain, originally Luofeng Mountain)
subLocations: 神手谷 (Divine Hand Valley) - 墨大夫's residence, Han Li's cultivation spot
sevenMysteriesSect.description: A mortal martial arts sect, NOT a cultivation sect. Han Li joined at age 10 as an outer disciple. This is where he received the mysterious 掌天瓶 (Heavenly Palm Bottle) and learned 长春功 (Eternal Spring Art) from墨大夫.
keyEvents: 墨大夫 tries to possess Han Li's body - Han Li kills him at age 16
Han Li leaves at age 18 to become a cultivator
sevenMysteriesSect.status: Still exists but irrelevant after Han Li enters cultivation world

yellowMapleValley.name: 黄枫谷 (Yellow Maple Valley)
yellowMapleValley.location: 越国 → 建州 → 太岳山脉 (Yue Country, Jianzhou, Taiyue Mountains, near border with Yuanwu)
yellowMapleValley.description: Yue Country's 2nd ranked sect. Han Li joined at age 19 through the 太南小会 (Tai Nan Gathering) trials using a 升仙令牌 (Ascension Token). He spent nearly all his Qi Condensation and Foundation Establishment years here.
keyEvents: Han Li joins at age 19 (Qi Condensation stage)
血色禁地 trial at age 21 - meets 南宫婉
Han Li reaches Foundation Establishment at age 25
Formation Establishment: forced to abandoned sect and relocate to 北凉国 when Devil Dao invades Yue Country
Sect continues to exist in 北凉国 under Nine Nations Alliance protection

fallingCloudSect.name: 落云宗 (Luoyun/Falling Cloud Sect)
fallingCloudSect.location: 天南 → 溪国 → 云梦山东部, 湳州 (Tiannan, Xi Country, East Cloud Dream Mountain, Nanzhou)
fallingCloudSect.description: Han Li joined this sect at age 204 under an alias after returning from Scattered Star Seas. He broke through to Nascent Soul (元婴) here at age 217 and became an elder. Under his influence, Luoyun Sect eventually became Tiannan's #1 sect. Associated with 大衍神君 (Dayan Divine Lord) and 银月 (Yinyue).
fallingCloudSect.neighbors: 云梦山三派 (Three Sects of Cloud Dream Mountain): 古剑门, 百巧院
fallingCloudSect.status: Flourished as Tiannan's #1 sect under Han Li's influence

starPalace.name: 星宫 (Star Palace)
starPalace.location: 乱星海 → 内星海 → 天星城 (Scattered Star Seas, Inner Sea, Tianxing City)
starPalace.hqStructure: 圣山 (Sacred Mountain) - 50+ levels on a giant island
starPalace.description: Ruling power of the Scattered Star Seas' Inner Sea. Founded by ancient cultivators. Controlled all key teleportation arrays and trade. Ruled by 天星双圣 (Twin Sages, 2 Late Nascent Soul cultivators).
keyEvents: Han Li rented cave abode on Layer 39 of Sacred Mountain
Civil war with Anti-Star Alliance (逆星盟)
Twin Sages self-destructed to severely wound 万三姑
Han Li killed 六道极圣 and helped Star Palace survive
Han Li obtained 元磁神山 from the aftermath

kunwuMountain.name: 昆吾山 (Kunwu Mountain)
kunwuMountain.location: 大晋 → 南疆 (Dajin, Southern Border)
kunwuMountain.description: Ancient immortal mountain sealed after the ancient demon invasion. Contained the split soul of 元刹圣祖 (one of Demon Realm's 3 invasion commanders). Sealed by 昆吾三老 using 黑风旗 and 八灵尺 (both Heaven-Connecting Spirit Treasures). When opened by Ye Family: 33 Nascent Soul cultivators died (11 Late Nascent Soul). Later, Mahayana-stage Han Li returned and slapped the entire mountain into the void with a thousand-zhang giant hand - only a bottomless pit remains.
kunwuMountain.sealedEntity: 元刹圣祖分身 (Yuan Cha Saint Ancestor split soul)
kunwuMountain.status: Destroyed (smashed into void by Han Li)

demonFallValley.name: 坠魔谷 (Demon Fall Valley)
demonFallValley.location: 天南 → 昌州山脉深处 (Tiannan, Changzhou, deep mountain ranges)
demonFallValley.description: Main battlefield of the ancient human-demon war. The demon army emerged from the mountains and fought a cataclysmic battle here. The demon leader 古魔血焰 (Ancient Demon Blood Flame) was defeated and seal-divided: body in special space, twin souls in Blood Curse Door. Contains 灵缈园 (Spirit Mist Garden). Even Nascent Soul cultivators fear entering.
demonFallValley.contains: 灵缈园 (Spirit Mist Garden) - transferred from Spirit Realm, key to Han Li's 元磁神光 cultivation

spatialDebates.description: Key geographic debates among fans since the author did not publish an official world map.

debates.topic: 大晋在天南的南方还是北方? (Is Dajin north or south of Tiannan?)
positions: Majority view: Dajin is SOUTH of Tiannan, accessed by traveling south through Mulan Grasslands
Minority view: Some argue Dajin is NORTH based on different textual interpretations
debates.resolution: Most fan maps place Dajin south of Tiannan, separated by Mulan Grasslands

debates.topic: 乱星海位置 (Where exactly are Scattered Star Seas?)
positions: Dominant: East of Tiannan, across Unbounded Sea
The teleportation formation in 紫金国 connects to it

debates.topic: 人界是否有统一大陆? (Is Mortal Realm one supercontinent?)
positions: Multiple continents separated by seas is the consensus
Dajin is the largest landmass, 10x Tiannan
debates.resolution: Multiple landmasses in a vast global ocean (无边海)
